subject: Surprize from the tree line
author: SUFFUR
body:
This clip is sadly not captured in the right view and i think it would be hard for Xan to do so, but as i come down the stairs, a car comes flying from the right side of the tress, like he spawned there and was waiting for me, that is why i crashed, when i did becasue i was looking back in my rear view mirror, to see what the frack, was going on. He can just be seen, in the clip behind me, but this view does not give it justice.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
